# Terms of Sale and Website Use

Effective: 29 October 2026

These terms cover buying from and using ai.clavexis.com, operated by **Clavexis**
(contact@clavexis.com). Use of the ClavexisAI software itself is covered by the
[End User Licence Agreement](/eula), which you sign at checkout.

**Your account.** Keep your password safe. You are responsible for activity on your account.
Give accurate details — we use your email to send licence keys and receipts.

**Prices and payment.** Prices, the currency, the ways to pay and who processes the payment are shown at checkout on ai.clavexis.com; those terms apply to your order. Your licence key is issued once the payment is confirmed.

**Discount codes.** A code applies only to the licences, dates and number of uses it was issued for,
can't be exchanged for cash or added to an order after it was placed, and one code applies per order.
We may withdraw a code that is being shared beyond its intended audience.

**Delivery.** Licence keys are shown in your account and emailed to you. Downloads are available
from the Download page.

**Monthly licences and renewal.** A monthly licence lasts for the month you paid for and does not
renew automatically. We'll remind you before it ends.

**Invoices.** A GST-compliant invoice for every paid order is available in your account. Give
your business name and GSTIN at checkout to receive a GST invoice in your business's name.

**Refunds.** See the [Refund Policy](/refunds).

**Acceptable use of the website.** Don't attack, overload, scrape or try to break into the website
or licence server, and don't buy with payment methods you aren't authorised to use.

**Availability.** We aim to keep the website and licence server running but don't guarantee it.
The software keeps working offline for up to 21 days between licence checks.

**Made by one developer.** ClavexisAI is designed, built and supported by a single independent
developer. That keeps it focused and fairly priced, but it also means replies, fixes and new
features can take a little longer than at a large company. If there's a feature you'd like, or
something you need that ClavexisAI doesn't do yet, email contact@clavexis.com. Every request is read,
and the ones that help the most people are built first. A request is not a promise that a feature
will be built or when.

**Changes.** We may update these terms; the version in force when you ordered applies to that order.

**Complaints and grievances.** Write to our Grievance Officer at contact@clavexis.com. We acknowledge complaints within 48 hours
and resolve them within one month of receipt. Our contact details and address are on the
[Contact page](/contact).

**Law.** These terms are governed by the laws of India; the courts having jurisdiction over our
registered office decide disputes.
